environment.description: Application deployed on the same EC2/ALB stack but with an AWS WAFv2 WebACL associated to the ALB. The WebACL contains two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0: AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with all rules in COUNT mode except 'SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING' which is in BLOCK mode with a 2048-byte query string limit, and (2) Priority 1: A custom rule group 'corp-sqli-body-inspection' containing a single rule with a RegexPatternSet match condition on SingleQueryArgument 'department' that matches the pattern `['";\-]{2}|union\s+(all\s+)?select|or\s+['"]?\d+['"]?\s*=\s*['"]?\d+` with action BLOCK, and a second rule matching SingleQueryArgument 'role' against the same RegexPatternSet with action BLOCK. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics are enabled for the WebACL with sampled requests logging. Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule that returns HTTP 400 for any request where the query string length exceeds 512 characters, evaluated before the default forward rule.

rules.name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
rules.note: All other rules in COUNT mode
